stage: exposed development; frozen before projected-Hamiltonian molecular predictions
input: same stationary embedded-PBE0 charge/spin response, lambda 0.9, F/Q one-body average 0.5/0.5
projection: unique unweighted Frobenius least-squares fermionic response in the orthonormal Lowdin basis
one_body: normal order to preserve the input mean Fock at its stationary reference density
active_space: common molecular occupied/virtual union of leading NTOs of the two retained target transitions; extend each sector by frontier canonical orbitals to three occupied and three virtual
wavefunction: CAS(6,6) spin-singlet full CI in the selected common active space, inactive orbitals frozen initially
assignment: transition-density overlap with retained target amplitudes, maximum-weight unique assignment; overlap >= 0.7 and margin >= 0.05
numerical_stage: vertical CASCI first; optimize orbitals only after character and energy diagnostics
